speaker: character
text: Timur replaced my module without asking. I want to leave this team.

speaker: candidate
text: Let's fix this fast, the demo is in three days.

speaker: character
text: How do I know this will not happen again?

speaker: candidate
text: From now on nobody changes someone's module without their review.

speaker: character
text: Will you make Timur the villain for this?

speaker: candidate
text: I'll talk to him myself, you focus on work.

speaker: character
text: Who decides which version we keep for the demo?

speaker: candidate
text: We assign owners now, freeze by Thursday, and run the full demo at six. After the demo we will keep reviews so nobody loses ownership again.

speaker: character
text: The Thursday run failed. What now?

speaker: candidate
text: We'll work all night and fix it.
